claim: The V5 recurrence implementation uses lambda=1 for the original rule and lambda=0.1 for anchoring.
Multi-prototype representation removes the constructed multimodal mean bottleneck.
Anchoring reduces trajectory displacement on the distractor family.
Anchored recurrence improves accuracy over its direct same-bank control by at least one point.
V5 establishes handwritten-digit efficacy or population generalization.
E6 R2 improves classification over its same-bank direct control.
E7 improves classification over its same-bank direct control on the official writer-independent partition.
Anchoring reduces displacement in E6 R2 and E7.
E6 R2 and E7 are noninferior to logistic regression at the declared -0.01 margin.
The hosted evidence is independently reproduced on a second GPU environment.
